parsed.notes: No actual ratio values are disclosed; the company only states it was in compliance with all covenants at September 30, 2026 (under the new Credit Agreement) and at December 31, 2025 (under the 2022 Credit Agreement). The 2022 Credit Agreement was amended and restated on March 27, 2026, and the maximum leverage ratio was tightened from 2.75x to 2.25x. Uses of the consolidated leverage ratio for interest margin and commitment fee pricing were excluded.
